text:
marta: quick follow-up from the observability/enrichment thread. sketched a minimal "ingest cost envelope" approach i want feedback on before i open an RFC.

sam: thanks. can you summarize the main operational goal in one sentence?

marta: make accurate cost attribution available at ingest time with minimal payload bloat and clear ownership, so billing dashboards and alerts don't need to wait on late enrichment.

deepa: current problem we see in customer dashboards: queries show a gap during replay/backfill because late-enrich adds tenant metadata after storage. so cost reconciliations are messy.

ryan: infra perspective: two obvious options  push attributes at edge (bigger ingest, simpler queries) or  keep ingest skinny and do heavy join during query. i prefer a hybrid.

marta: hybrid = small envelope (<=1KB) at ingest with billing_key, tenant_id, sample_cohort, and a producer_confidence flag. other enrichment can be late.

sam: producer_confidence? meaning?
marta: values = high|low|derived. high = producer asserted canonical key, low = producer best-effort, derived = gateway fallback. billing rules treat high differently.

deepa: rollout plan? a lot of producers don't send any billing info today.
marta: phased rollout: (1) validation-only for 14 days (gateway emits metrics but accepts), (2) gateway derives key when missing and tags as derived for 30 days, (3) enforce presence after 90 days. per-producer exemptions possible.

ryan: sampling interplay: we pre-sample at edge for high-volume flows. envelope must capture pre_sample_decision and sample_cohort so we can reconstruct aggregate cost. for pre-sampled-out traces emit a small stub with envelope + trace_id.

infra-bot: note: schema-validator deploy to staging scheduled 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

sam: storage/indexing questions: which envelope fields are indexed? indexing everything kills storage costs.
marta: index only billing_key and sample_cohort. tenant_id kept as low-cardinality tag in a small shard. rest stored as blob.

deepa: what about materializing common joins? if product teams need enrichment fields often we should run async projection jobs to materialize popular joins to analytics store. avoids repeated query joins.

ryan: fallback and SLA: if enrichment services are down we still must surface billing. with envelope at ingest billing teams have visibility even if enrichment pipeline is degraded.

marta: metrics and ownership: gateway must emit missing_envelope_count, derived_key_count, and per-producer failure_rate. billing team owns mapping/canonicalization rules. sdk/producer teams own best-effort population.

sam: size limits: gateways must reject envelopes >1KB and emit a reject metric. include sample JSON in RFC.

marta: action items:
- marta: draft RFC with schema + phased rollout + sample messages (due Fri).
- sam: estimate index size/annual storage delta + query cost model.
- deepa: draft billing rules for high/low/derived keys.
- ryan: design sample stub for pre-sampled-out traces.

marta: sample envelope for RFC (will include proto/json):
```json
{"billing_key":"acct:acme-42","tenant_id":"acme","sample_cohort":"cohort-7","pre_sample_decision":"keep","producer_confidence":"derived","ingest_version":"v1"}
```

deepa: looks good. minor nit: rename pre_sample_decision -> pre_sample_action with values [keep,drop,stub] for clarity.
marta: good call, i'll update. i'll send PR tomorrow and tag infra for the staging validator run.

sam: +1. thanks.
